result.notes: API tokens (basic auth) and OAuth 2.0 (3LO) app registration are both self-serve/free via an Atlassian account and developer console — no paid tier or approval needed to obtain credentials for private/dev use; Marketplace distribution requires review but that's not a blocker for building an agent toolkit. Atlassian also publishes an official hosted remote MCP server (GA Feb 2026) supporting OAuth 2.1 or API tokens, in addition to numerous community MCP servers (sooperset/mcp-atlassian, etc.).
